job.job_description:
What You'll Be Working On
Develop and maintain Devfolio backend APIs and services, both public-facing and internal.
Ensure APIs and services are highly performant, secure, and scalable.
Work with technologies including Node.js, Python, Golang, Redis, MySQL, PostgreSQL, and other open-source tools.
Grow over time into leading, training, and scaling the backend engineering team.
Build experiences that shape an iconic product while taking ownership of critical systems.
You'll Fit In If
You have experience building public APIs.
You have worked on SaaS or consumer products and enjoy crafting high-quality backend systems.
You have experience building, scaling, and maintaining large-scale systems (preferred).
You are a fast learner and can quickly adapt to new technologies.
You work well independently while collaborating effectively with teams.
You enjoy building products from scratch.
You understand business constraints and build with users and business impact in mind.
Join Us
Full-time or 6-month internship opportunities.
Workspace setup provided.
Competitive stipend or salary.
Generous stock options for full-time employees.
Perks Benefits
Unlimited paid leave.
Flexible working hours with an asynchronous work culture.
Personalized workstation setup (Mac, Windows, Linux, mechanical keyboard, and more).
Annual team retreats with meals and accommodation for Bangalore HQ visits.
Wellness allowance for gym memberships, meditation apps, and other wellness expenses.
Comprehensive health insurance coverage of 20L, including health check-ups, unlimited doctor consultations, dental care, and accident insurance.
